nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$, every $\zeta \in R$ and every natural number $n$, the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling number $J(n,n;\zeta)$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Diagonal of the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$, every $\zeta \in R$ and every natural number $k$, the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling number $J(0,k;\zeta)$ equals $1$ if $k = 0$ and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Initial row of the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$, an element $\zeta \in R$ and a natural number $n$, the $n$-th first-kind Jacobi–Stirling generating polynomial is $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (X - i(i + \zeta))$ in $R[X]$.
nodes.title: Generating polynomial of the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$, every $\zeta \in R$ and all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers satisfy $J(n+1,k+1;\zeta) = J(n,k;\zeta) - n(n + \zeta)\,J(n,k+1;\zeta)$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For every commutative ring $R$, every $\zeta \in R$ and all natural numbers $n < k$, the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling number $J(n,k;\zeta)$ equals $0$.
nodes.title: First-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers vanish above the diagonal

nodes.summary: For a commutative ring $R$, an element $\zeta \in R$ and natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the first-kind Jacobi–Stirling number $J(n,k;\zeta)$ is the coefficient of $X^k$ in the polynomial $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (X - i(i + \zeta))$ over $R$.
nodes.title: First-kind Jacobi–Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the Legendre–Stirling number of the first kind $J(n, n; 1)$ equals $1$.
nodes.title: Diagonal Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n < k$, the Legendre–Stirling number of the first kind $J(n, k; 1)$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind vanish above the diagonal

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the polynomial $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} \bigl(X - i(i+1)\bigr)$ with integer coefficients; for $n = 0$ it is the empty product $1$.
nodes.title: Generating polynomial of the Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind satisfy $J(n + 1, k + 1; 1) = J(n, k; 1) - n(n + 1) \, J(n, k + 1; 1)$.
nodes.title: Recurrence for the Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, the Legendre–Stirling number of the first kind $J(0, k; 1)$ equals $1$ if $k = 0$ and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: Initial row of the Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the Legendre–Stirling number of the first kind $J(n, k; 1)$ is the coefficient of $x^k$ in the integer polynomial $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} \bigl(x - i(i+1)\bigr)$, which is $1$ when $n = 0$. These are the Jacobi–Stirling numbers of the first kind $J(n, k; \zeta)$ at $\zeta = 1$.
nodes.title: Legendre–Stirling numbers of the first kind

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
